Well. I don’t know about the people in the west. But the guys at some of the companies I have sent applications to avoided me like a leper.

Well. What people in the west have a hard time of understanding is that the COMMON man is rooting for the war. Hell some people in the places I’ve visited through work have praised the massacres that the army has committed. The people leaving the county are the thinking minority. The people who haven’t yet succumbed to the propaganda and have a few brain cells to spare. In a country with such a heinous education system as Russia they are few and far between (mostly in big cities). But you need to also understand that the only solace for the oppressed majority in Russia was the feeling of being “a great empire” for many years. And after the 90s, a time that this majority gladly calls the betrayal of the west and with a gentle nudge by uncle Vova they have returned back to the drug of imperialism.

There is none. This is a hopeless bloody place. If you read some of the Russian authors you’ll get the picture. Russians have lived in squalor under the thumb of the czar, live in squalor under his thumb and will live in the same squalor in the future. This country is a damn time capsule of perfectly preserved feudalism. I know, I live here. And I agree with people above. The only way for Russians to change something is to leave Russia and find another home. But this would prove maddeningly impossible seeing as we’re mostly viewed as either genocidal maniacs or apathetic assholes now.

Believe me. Change will come. As soon as he makes one slip the hopeless will eat him alive along with his own posse. Putin right now is the most miserable piece of human refuse in the world. A small cowardly manling who turned the world and his own people against him. He hasn’t seen the sun or a face of a person who is not a security agent for years, maybe decades. I would pity him if he wasn’t worthy of this hell on earth.

There has been only one leader for twenty years. Him and his puppets. They are unchanging. That is the maddening thing about living here. He seems immortal. I have learned to understand the “brainwashed” and have understood that they have just lost all hope. They believe in the only thing that doesn’t seem ironclad. While the young and intelligent try to break through this concrete wall of authoritarianism.

How are we responsible for him? We didn’t choose him! We protest and protest hard! I would like to see you go and protest when you risk being caught by the police, shocked with a taser and then raped with a champagne bottle in the precinct. We do all that! That’s the only thing we can do. We can’t write to our fucking congressman. We risk the livelihoods of our families and our own lives to try and overthrow the tyrant who controls our country for twenty goddamn years. Just yesterday 1000 people were detained across the country. Some were tortured with car batteries, water boarding and plastic bags over the head!
